regime.call: Chip-led US rally extends; Nvidia scandal risk unpriced

risk_appetite.evidence: SOX +4.21% and NDX +1.35% led a broad US bounce, with MTUM +1.85% and IWM/SPY +0.68% showing momentum and small caps also bid, even as Fear & Greed sits at 22 (extreme fear) and TAIEX fell 4.51%.

liquidity.evidence: The liquidity composite reads neutral (score 0): TGA fell $42.552B and bank reserves rose $36.318B (both easing), while NFCI ticked up to -0.459 from -0.467, a mild tightening signal; RRP stayed at $0B.

volatility.evidence: VIX fell 9.01% to 25.64 and VVIX is 9.7% off its 134.99 peak, but SKEW rose 2.80% to 153.55 (a 52-week-high-adjacent tail-hedging level) and VIX9D at 27.18 sits above spot VIX, both signs the de-escalation is incomplete.

contradicts: Fear & Greed sits at 22 (extreme fear) the same day SOX rallied 4.21% and NDX rallied 1.35%, meaning sentiment has not confirmed the price action.

falsifiers.threshold: NVDA closes down more than 3% on Monday
falsifiers.meaning: Would show the Nvidia CEO investigation is repricing the chip rally rather than staying a single-day headline.
Would show Friday's 4.21% chip rebound failed to hold and the AI-regulation/chip selloff is resuming.
Would show today's volatility pullback was temporary and the fear spike is reasserting.

regime.for_w52_engine: Both engine legs rose again today, with SOX (the SMH leg) up 4.21% outpacing NDX (the QQQ leg) up 1.35%, extending Friday's rebound; see the live page for the Supertrend line values.
regime.confidence_reason: The three axes conflict (risk-on price action versus extreme-fear and rising-SKEW readings) and a fresh, unquantified governance shock at Nvidia (the largest weight in both engine legs) broke after today's close and is not yet priced.

review.yesterday_call: US equities bounce back; AI-regulation fallout still hits Asia
review.note: None of yesterday's falsifiers hit and the US-bounce/Asia-weak direction holds, but today adds a new, unpriced risk factor (the Nvidia CEO investigation) that yesterday's call could not have anticipated.

daily_summary: US chips rallied Friday but Nvidia's new CEO investigation is an unpriced Monday risk
alert: Nvidia's board opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang over an alleged relationship with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, disclosed after Friday's close and not yet reflected in SOX's 4.21% rally.
